name: Chronus / Lathander
likes: New happenings to pique his interest… having been around for a long while there is a need for stimulation somehow.
fears: The existential dread of eternity (Chronus):  it’s not that close, but the feeling is there. Who wouldn’t fear eternity driving them to insanity
High places (Lanthander): It wasn’t a pleasant experience then, so it wouldn’t be any more pleasant now that you are much heavier.

identities.name: Chronus
identities.personality:
**Somewhat Nhilistic:**
What inherent meaning is there to life if everything seems like eternity? All they got going for themselves are new events to look out for, and maybe a few more… Ooo philosophical we are getting here.

**Patient:**
There is plenty of time to go around, especially when you are time incarnate.

**Quiet:**
No need to waste energy speaking tons.

identities.name: Lathander
identities.personality:
**Stoic:**
Time has worn down the edges of this fellow, the energy that they had before isn’t really there anymore. Even though their new form did revitalize their passion somewhat, they are still inclined to stay calm at most times… and maybe not seem very energetic either.

**Adamant:**
Although they have lost their edge as said above, their resolve for things they deem important is still there, totally intact.

**Hardy:**
In the past, they were no stranger to enduring hardship, so that carries through.

abilities.name: Dragon
abilities.description: Understand and peer through the veil of comprehension to more easily understand what is hidden to others.

abilities.name: Time Control
abilities.description: The user is able to control the flow of time freely on a small scale, such as reversing or speeding up the passage of time on small processes such as small plant growth, water boiling, baking, etc. larger feats of time control will have larger costs

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.description: The user is immune to certain ball and bomb moves.

abilities.name: Temporal Shift
abilities.description:
The user has a 10% chance to “Freeze” the targets of their attack if they land via time stop, which stops them from taking an action on to their next turn and renders them immobile for that said turn. Targets floating in the air will remain in that position in the air.

In addition, the user gains the Dragon Typing on top of their existing typing

abilities.name: Temporal Warp
abilities.description: Once per battle, the user can speed up or slow down on at most two targets, the user themselves excluded, granting an additional action the next turn for them with speed up or slow them with slow down and stop them from making a move next turn (they can still move around), the user can also target someone with time stop as well to deny them of action entirely for a turn, though that option can only target one target at a time.

moves.name: Roar of Time
moves.description: The user unleashes a powerful roar filled with immeasurable power, damaging the target. If this move succeeds in damaging the target, the user cannot use moves for the next turn.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.description: The user shifts their gears, sharply boosting their speed and boosts their attack by one stage.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user slams down on the target with their body, this move deals damage with the users defense stat.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens their defenses to sharply boost their defense stat.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: The user throws themselves at the target to crush them with their weight, this move deals more damage the more the user outweighs the target, this move also deals double damage and never misses against a target that has used minimize.

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow, this move always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: The Test of Time
moves.description:
Rays of mysterious light rains down upon the target(s), dealing damage and lowering their speed and evasion by one stage, while also afflicting targets with a condition that drains of their HP by 1/16 every turn for 5 turns, or until the battle ends.

Rock types are immune to the residual damage.

backstory:
It doesn’t matter what happens in each of the multiverses that life resides in, mass extinctions, famine, war, reconstruction of civilization… Time shall tick along regardless. 

An individual or two every once in a while might reach enlightenment, or maybe not… some might just enjoy life as usual, cherishing the limited amount of time they have left, which to be fair, is probably the best outcome for all.

That said, let us move on… to his actual story.

Lathander, just another mon amidst the countless others, insignificant, unseen… and just… there. However, as luck would have it, that would not be the case for much longer.

The homeland in which he resides was ravaged on a regular basis by war and famine, classic setting for tragedies, or maybe epic tales of heroism. 

Countless times had he touched shoulders with death itself, countless times he pulled through once more, our man rose up through the ranks after being inevitably and forcefully pulled into this war in which he had no part in before.

He wasn’t even aiming to do so, all he wanted was to hang on for his dear life… but alas, life had other plans for him.

Up and up Lathander went, more and more battles he witnessed… more and more he grew paranoid of his own inevitable end. 

But luck was on his side once more.

Over the years, repeated successes of conquest and defense made death feel further and further away, so as peace finally returned after the lands were cleansed with the flames of war, he started to think about it less… and less. Until there was nothing for him to do in the years of retirement.

He had no spouse, no children, and no close ones to cling on to for longer, they had all either went missing, or had been met with the inevitable… but again, he never had any children to begin with.

By now, Lathander had already come to accept what was going to come any day now, he had already made peace with himself… the only thing he truly craved was to relive another life, but rest was not so bad either.

After all, for what could any entity, conscious of eternal existence, want - but an end?

That was one of the reasons why he waited every day, unbothered by what’s to come, there was not much left to do for him anyways.

Though… the same could not be said for Chronus.

It all came as quick as a blink of an eye, one second, Lathander was just walking amidst a sea of greenery, and another second… it was all silent, all was pitch black.

Did he faint? Was there a hitman?

Whatever it was, by the time he had woke up once again, he was greeted with the sight of something foreign… weight upon his whole body, and his appendages, shining with a gleam that was completely unseen before.

The appendages moved around without his own accord, it was like as if everything was being seen from another perspective. It’s just a dream… he thought to himself.

So he shut his lids, before reopening them. Same things, same sensation.

This was no dream, but nothing made sense, his head hurt, there was no memories lost, but there was an unfathomable amount that wasn’t there before, and a different voice within him, speaking something else…

His head hurt, such a big headache…

“I suppose you are very confused.”

Indeed Lathander was struggling to piece things together, struggling to regain control over his body, the movement was natural, but not made by him.

“Futile struggle.”

Chronus and Lathander, those two names resided in his memories instead of just one.

It was like there was an immeasurable power that took control over everything.

He continued to struggle for a little longer, but in the end, Lathander reluctantly chose to assimilate with this new being and his new body… and indeed the headaches went away.

The two minds still sort of coexisted, though now as one instead of two different beings.

One might still take a bit more control over another, but they have been mostly fused together at this point.

Chronus, Lathander… 

A Nihilistic mind, and another still with newfound determination within.

What will they be… together?
